content.rendered: Calling all incoming Kindergartners for the 2025-2026 school year! Archer Glen is hosting our Kindergarten Open House from 4:00 – 6:00 pm. If you have a child who will be 5 years of age by 9/1/25, please come and learn more about all things Kindergarten.
